title: Track it! (Remix)
style: Electro-swing with a high-energy big band influence. Features a prominent female vocal with a playful, aggressive delivery. Instrumentation includes a syncopated brass section with trumpets and trombones, a walking upright bass, and a driving electronic drum kit with a crisp snare and heavy kick. A recurring staccato synth-bass riff mirrors the vocal rhythm. The track features record scratch effects, vocal chops, and growled vocal ad-libs. Tempo is 124 BPM in the key of G minor. The arrangement uses frequent stop-start dynamics and rhythmic stabs.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[record scratch, syncopated brass stabs, electronic drums]

[Verse 1]
[female vocals, staccato synth-bass riff]
Track it
Like some kind of animal
Eyes fixed, we're mixed channel
Your mammal
Track it
Like some kind of animal
Instincts, distinct, wild [growled vocal ad-lib]

[Chorus]
[brass section enters, driving beat]
Track it, track it, track it, track it
Track it, track it, track it, track it
You're the beast
It's within you
Let it go wild
[vocal chop] Track it, track it, track it, track it
Track it, track it, track it, track it
Just track it, track it, track it
Like some kind of animal
[vocal chop] Track it, track it, track it, track it
Track it, track it, track it, track it
[growled vocal ad-lib]
Like some kind of animal

[Bridge]
[upright bass solo, finger snaps]
[brass stabs]

[Outro]
[vocal chop] Track it, track it, track it, track it
Track it, track it, track it, track it
Like some kind of animal
